meaning:
ἐπι-βιβάζω
[in LXX chiefly for רָכַב hi. ;]
to place upon: with accusative of person(s), Luk.10:34 19:35, Act.23:24.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
He asked them to provide animals, that they might set Paul on one, and bring him safely to Felix the governor.
